description: Get Wield a recipe for a website task that has none yet. Two ways: mode "request" (default) adds the site and task to Wield's public request list (only the site and task text are sent, no user data). Mode "record" builds a private recipe right now: the user does the task once in their own Chrome while Wield records it; values they type, cookies and tokens are removed on their computer and they review what is sent before anything leaves it. Only use "record" when the user agreed to show the task in their browser; tell them to switch to Chrome and click Done when finished. It needs a Wield API key and credits: a recipe that passes verification costs $2. After the build the draft is tested in the user's Chrome: an Allow window opens there and the user must click Allow within 2 minutes. A draft that reads the user's own account is tested with real values from it: when the answer says needs "test_params", fill them from what the user said (or ask), and call again with rec_id and test_params. A kept draft is retested by rec_id without a new build or charge. A recording made earlier from the extension's popup can be used with rec_id. Keep personal details out of the task text.

mode.description: request (default): ask Wield to build it; record: the user shows the task once and a private recipe is built now

rebuild.description: Record mode with rec_id: build a new draft from the recording ($2) instead of testing the kept one

rec_id.description: Record mode: use a saved recording (one from the extension popup, or one this tool kept). Its draft, if one was built, is tested again without a new build or charge

site.description: Site domain or URL, e.g. 'zalando.de' (record mode needs a domain)

task.description: The task, e.g. 'track my order status'

test_params.description: Record mode: real values to test the draft with, from the user's own account (e.g. their project's name). They stay on this computer and are never sent to the builder

name: request_recipe
title: Request or record a new recipe
